From "I saved it" to "I'm going there"

Five simple steps powered by AI location intelligence

1

Analyze Travel Posts

Connect Instagram or TikTok. We scan your saved travel content including videos, captions, and comments for location clues.

2

Detect Locations

AI extracts location names from speech, text, and hashtags. "Hidden waterfall in Bali" becomes a pinned map location automatically.

3

Save to Your Map

All detected locations are automatically saved to your personal travel map, organized by category and destination.
